formalizations.formalization: ∀ (a : Point) (b : Point) (c : Point) (d₁ : Point) (d₂ : Point) (d₃ : Point) (AB : Line) (BC : Line) (AC : Line) (D₁₂ : Line) (D₂₃ : Line), ((formTriangle a b c AB BC AC) ∧ (formRectilinearAngle d₁ d₂ d₃ D₁₂ D₂₃) ∧ ((∠ d₁:d₂:d₃ : ℝ) > 0) ∧ ((∠ d₁:d₂:d₃ : ℝ) < ∟ + ∟)) → (∃ (f g e c' : Point) (FG EC EF CG : Line), formParallelogram f g e c' FG EC EF CG ∧ (∠ c':e:f = ∠ d₁:d₂:d₃) ∧ (Triangle.area △ f:e:c' + Triangle.area △ f:c':g = Triangle.area △ a:b:c))
formalizations.full_output: theorem example_thm (a b c d₁ d₂ d₃ : Point) (AB BC AC D₁₂ D₂₃: Line) (h1 : formTriangle a b c AB BC AC) (h2 : formRectilinearAngle d₁ d₂ d₃ D₁₂ D₂₃) (h3 : (∠ d₁:d₂:d₃ : ℝ) > 0) (h4 : (∠ d₁:d₂:d₃ : ℝ) < ∟ + ∟) : ∃ (f g e c' : Point) (FG EC EF CG : Line), formParallelogram f g e c' FG EC EF CG ∧ (∠ c':e:f = ∠ d₁:d₂:d₃) ∧ (Triangle.area △ f:e:c' + Triangle.area △ f:c':g = Triangle.area △ a:b:c) := by

formalizations.formalization: ∀ (a : Point) (b : Point) (c : Point) (AB : Line) (AC : Line), ((formRectilinearAngle a b c AB AC) ∧ (∠ a:b:c = ∟ + ∟)) → (∃ (d e f : Point), distinctPointsOnLine d e AB ∧ distinctPointsOnLine f a AC ∧ ∠ d:e:f = ∠ e:f:a ∧ ∠ d:e:f = ∠ f:a:e ∧ ∠ e:f:a + ∠ f:a:e = ∠ d:e:f)
formalizations.full_output: theorem thm (a b c : Point) (AB AC : Line) (h1 : formRectilinearAngle a b c AB AC) (h2 : ∠ a:b:c = ∟ + ∟) : ∃ (d e f : Point), distinctPointsOnLine d e AB ∧ distinctPointsOnLine f a AC ∧ ∠ d:e:f = ∠ e:f:a ∧ ∠ d:e:f = ∠ f:a:e ∧ ∠ e:f:a + ∠ f:a:e = ∠ d:e:f := by

reference_formalization: ∀ (a b c : Point) (AB AC : Line), formRectilinearAngle b a c AB AC ∧ AB ≠ AC → ∃ f : Point, f ≠ a ∧ (∠ b:a:f = ∠ c:a:f)
nl_statement: To cut a given rectilinear angle in half. Let $BAC$ be the given rectilinear angle. So it is required to cut it in half.    <prf>  Thus, angle $DAF$ is equal to angle $EAF$ [Prop.~1.8]. Thus, the given rectilinear angle $BAC$ has been cut in half by the straight-line $AF$.
